correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction from the exact source equations confirms tr J=-(d+d1+c+γ+βDv+β1βvT). From dot T/T=λ/T-βDv-d and dot D/D=λ1/D-β1βvT-γ, the claimed pointwise cohomology follows identically; integrate and use Liouville to obtain the exact endpoint ratio and exponential. On an ω-periodic strictly positive solution the endpoint ratio equals one and λ/T, λ1/D>0, proving det Φ(ω)<exp[-∫(d1+c)]<1. det Φ is positive and equals the product of the complex multiplier moduli, so at least one modulus is strictly below the stated fourth-root baseline. All quantifiers (continuity of coefficients, positivity of T,D; periodicity only for the Floquet portion) and normalization Φ(0)=I were checked. Independent SymPy Jacobian/cohomology identities vanish algebraically; numerical integration of a nonperiodic one-period segment gives det 0.669254913853902 vs both Liouville and endpoint-corrected expression 0.669254913853891, confirming the endpoint factor is necessary off-cycle. The numerical check is not the infinite proof.
residual_risks: Positive locked-cycle existence is inherited conditionally from the source paper; the determinant formula does not prove it.
Numerical example starts near, not exactly on, a periodic orbit; the finite-time endpoint ratio 1.00089045 is required, and no numerical extrapolation is used for a theorem.

value.rationale: The ONLY advertised dynamical consequence is a volume contraction and at least one contracting Floquet multiplier. Yet without any cohomological calculation, the published positive four-state model has tr J=-(d+d1+c+γ+βDv+β1βvT)<-(d+d1+c+γ) at every positive state. Liouville already gives the STRICTLY STRONGER periodic estimate det Φ(ω)<exp[-∫(d+d1+c+γ)]<exp[-∫(d1+c)], and the same fourth-root multiplier deduction. For the published forcing averages the elementary upper bound is 0.8874700356624355 versus the claimed 0.9043571086383213. The exact alternative representation in λ/T and λ1/D is merely the sum of two displayed logarithmic state balances and adds no sharper parameter threshold, sign change, stability classification, bifurcation diagnosis, or new computable invariant. No independently motivated use of the new coordinates is established. Therefore a cheap routine divergence normalization yielding a weaker previously implied conclusion fails the common mathematical-value bar, even though its equality is correct and its formatting may be absent from indexed sources. A repair would require a genuinely substantive surviving theorem, not disclaimers, extra verification or rephrasing; none is supplied.
residual_risks: A future application might exploit the λ/T and λ1/D representation for observational inference, but no such theorem, model identifiability condition or substantial mathematical role is proved in this package.
A negative verdict concerns demonstrated mathematical value of this submitted final claim; it does not assert that source-model stability questions themselves are unimportant.
